name: model_statistics
description: Model overview (pure read): project name, element and type totals, loadable family count, non-template view and sheet counts, element counts per category (sorted desc) and per level (with elevation in mm), plus health numbers: warning count, Revit link count, CAD import count. Set include_types=true for the top 50 family/type instance counts. Simplified from the C# original: one pass over the model instead of a rescan per level, and warnings/links/imports added.

params.name: include_types
params.description: Also return per family/type instance counts (top 50 by count, loadable families only). Off by default to keep the response small.
